The Savoy Male and Female College      47

SENIOR YEAR
Fall Term
    Tacitus
    Alcestis of Euripides
    Select Course in Reading
    Political Economy
    Geology
    Astronomy

Spring Term
    Juvenal
    Phaedo of Plato and Aristophanes' Clouds
    Christian Ethics
    Mineralogy
    Surveying and Navigation
    French or German will be required in the A.B.
course.

    Note:—A more extended course is admissible when desired.³¹

    Comparison of the Courses.—As compared with the course for the B. S. degree, this comprehensive program is thus seen to include the following extra requirements:

        Languages:  Four years of Greek
                    One year of Latin
        Science:    Meteorology, Botany, Zoology
        English:    Composition and Declamation, two
                        years
                    English and American Literature,
                        two-thirds of a year
                    "A Select Reading Course," one-third
                        of a year
        History:    Ancient History, one-third year
        Philosophy: Logic, one-third year

    But the B.S. degree demanded more mathematics—perhaps a year's work—in Calculus and Analytical Geometry, and also specified perhaps a third of a year's work in Geology not listed for the A.B. degree. From this comparison it appears that, although the work for each degree is outlined for four college years, the student taking the more strenuous degree would have enough additional course requirements to require two extra years for completion.

³¹Ibid., pp. 9 and 10.
